name: Sepia ~Oumagatoki no Monogatari~
source:
Makoto Yuna is a student council president and grandchild of the president of a prestigious education academy. An earthquake strikes them with a friend blocking all the aisles with jelly-like wall effectively trapping them. Who stands behind it and what will happen to them?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
尤奈诚是学生会会长，也是著名教育学院院长的孙子。一场地震袭击了他们，一位朋友用果冻状的墙堵住了所有过道，有效地困住了他们。谁在背后支持？他们会发生什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
